data.one_liner: Automated error catching and reporting plugin for Flutter with multiple handlers.
data.what_it_does: Catcher 2 automatically catches uncaught exceptions/errors in Flutter applications and provides multiple reporting options like dialogs, notifications, console logs, email sending, Sentry, and custom HTTP requests. It supports Android, iOS, Web, Linux, Windows, and macOS.
use_when: You need to catch uncaught Flutter and Dart exceptions automatically across multiple platforms.
You want configurable reporting flows such as showing error dialogs to users or emailing crash logs.
avoid_when: You only need lightweight logging without UI crash dialogs or reporting handlers.
strengths: Supports multiple built-in handlers (Console, Email, Sentry, Toast, HTTP, Discord, Slack, etc.).
Cross-platform support including mobile, web, and desktop.
Easy setup with debug and release configurations.
weaknesses: Requires proper navigator key configuration for dialog and page report modes to function.
data.setup_notes: Initialize with Catcher2 in main() and add Catcher2.navigatorKey to your MaterialApp/CupertinoApp.
